three_innovations.name: HGS-F/HGS-E/HGS-M机制视角分解
closest_work: Zhao et al. 2024 PDF pp.9-10: one HGS population plus DP split
Wang et al. 2025 PDF pp.13-18: problem-aware route evaluation plus route pool and SP
three_innovations.difference: No located source has three independent fossil/simplified-EV/mechanism-aware proxy populations with common write-back.
three_innovations.repository_evidence: paper_main.tex:1225-1228 explicitly does not split a common total budget; single-case CPU is 1.84 min versus 0.50/0.63/0.64; public V13 deactivates missing mechanism fields at line 1110; no one-factor equal-total-compute formal comparison exists.

three_innovations.name: 跨轮累积路线池加限时MIP集合划分
closest_work: Rochat and Taillard 1995 PDF pp.3-5,7-8: adaptive route memory plus exact set partitioning post-optimization
Wang et al. 2025 PDF pp.13-18: ILS-generated high-quality route pool plus set partitioning
three_innovations.difference: ReSETP adds three mechanism views, cross-round permanent accumulation, full-model rescoring and a time limit.
three_innovations.repository_evidence: mvhgssp_bks_reproduction_full_20260727 passed 13/18 targets and only PR14B has strict SP attribution of 0.183; boundary_probe_20260726/report.md reports rich-pool 3 wins/3 losses and 12/12 initial final sources from HGS rather than SP.

three_innovations.name: 严格改善才接受的单调规则
closest_work: Lei and Hao 2026 Algorithm 1 PDF pp.8-9: incumbent updated only when f(S')<f(S*)
Zhao et al. 2024 PDF pp.9-10: survivor/diversification with best preservation
three_innovations.difference: ReSETP writes the min-accepted incumbent back to all three views and retains it across rounds.
three_innovations.repository_evidence: china81_vs_opensource_20260727/decision.json.transition_counts.M_to_MV={improve:114,regress:0,tie:291}; zero regressions are mechanically guaranteed by paper_main.tex:1227 min acceptance; no acceptance-rule ablation exists.
